_about: A general store: heals, Juice, revives, cures, Camp Stoves and throwables. `stock` lists item ids from data/items/items.json (prices come from there, so the shop, the sim and the sell-back price always agree). 'kind' is general or gear; a gear shop only lists ids from data/items/equipment.json. Placeholder shop for the test room; the real Harrow shops arrive with M3-4.
name: Corner Store
greeting: Welcome! Mind the cat. Everything's priced to move.
